inspiration.observed_pattern: A full outer relationship preserves matched rows plus rows present only on either side of a join key.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored shipment coverage report. MariaDB-compatible LEFT JOIN and unmatched-right UNION ALL branches emulate the full outer relationship, then ROW_NUMBER orders matched and unmatched inventory rows together while CASE and COALESCE classify the preserved side. The source tables, names, values, aliases, and educational examples are not copied.

fixture_notes: Depot 11 has a shipment and must be classified matched; depot 12 has no shipment and must remain as a NULL-extended left row; shipment 903 has no depot and must survive through the unmatched-right branch. ROW_NUMBER assigns a stable report order across all three rows.
determinism_notes: Depot and shipment identifiers, branch predicates, CASE labels, and window ordering are fixed. The final projection orders by its generated row number; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE shipping_depots (depot_id INT PRIMARY KEY, depot_name VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE depot_shipments (shipment_id INT PRIMARY KEY, depot_id INT NULL, package_count INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO shipping_depots VALUES (11, 'North dock'), (12, 'South dock')

steps.sql: WITH full_rows AS (SELECT d.depot_id, d.depot_name, s.shipment_id, s.package_count FROM shipping_depots AS d LEFT JOIN depot_shipments AS s ON s.depot_id = d.depot_id UNION ALL SELECT d.depot_id, d.depot_name, s.shipment_id, s.package_count FROM depot_shipments AS s LEFT JOIN shipping_depots AS d ON d.depot_id = s.depot_id WHERE d.depot_id IS NULL) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN depot_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(depot_id, shipment_id), shipment_id) AS report_order, depot_id, depot_name, shipment_id, package_count, CASE WHEN depot_id IS NULL THEN 'shipment-only' WHEN shipment_id IS NULL THEN 'depot-only' ELSE 'matched' END AS coverage_state FROM full_rows ORDER BY report_order

checks.sql: SELECT depot_id, depot_name, shipment_id, package_count FROM (SELECT d.depot_id, d.depot_name, s.shipment_id, s.package_count FROM shipping_depots AS d LEFT JOIN depot_shipments AS s ON s.depot_id = d.depot_id UNION ALL SELECT d.depot_id, d.depot_name, s.shipment_id, s.package_count FROM depot_shipments AS s LEFT JOIN shipping_depots AS d ON d.depot_id = s.depot_id WHERE d.depot_id IS NULL) AS full_rows ORDER BY COALESCE(depot_id, shipment_id), shipment_id
